head: Rank
Ability
rows:
Card Duplication:
Allows Yusuke to duplicate Skill Cards after 1 day.

Follow Up:
Chance to perform a follow-up attack if Joker's attack does not down the enemy.

Art Talk:
If negotiation with a lone Shadow fails, you can try again.

Card Creation:
Allows Yusuke to create any Skill Card he has copied before after 1 day.

Harisen Recovery:
Chance to cure status ailments inflicted upon party members.

Live Painting:
Allows Yusuke to use Card Duplication and Card Creation on the spot.

Endure:
Chance to withstand an otherwise fatal attack with 1 HP remaining.

Protect:
Chance to shield Joker from an otherwise fatal attack.

Second Awakening:
Evolves Persona.
